explication: OpenSpot Music is a pair of independent mobile and desktop streaming apps. The principal workflow is discovering tracks or collections, building a queue, and listening; users can also download music, manage likes and playlists, import public Spotify playlists, and browse regional trending music and artist catalogs. The tree and README establish these capabilities, while sampled source confirms search, queue persistence, playlist resolution, likes, and remote playback controls. Other feature wiring is not shown, so uncertain connections are omitted.
